name: memray-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Memray, a memory profiler for Python applications.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the `memray` package in `src/memray` together with `README.md`, the
documentation pages directly under `docs/` and `docs/examples/README.rst` that document it; the
tutorials in `docs/tutorials`, the example programs and the supported-environments page are not
part of it.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away.

Keep the public API and the command line interface stable, and keep every behavior that already
matches its documentation working exactly as it does now.

The compiled extension modules are already built next to the Python sources in `src/memray`, and
`PYTHONPATH` points at `/workdir/src`, so `python -m memray` and `import memray` use the code in
this repository.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-f
